pages: A stone well stands on a dry hill, with a wooden windlass, its handle rubbed shiny in two patches and grey rope coiled round the drum. Middle distance: a low roof of birch bark on posts. Background: thin brown grass falling away to the river flats and grey village roofs far below. Low late-summer sun on grey stone.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, arms folded, beside a boy three years older with both hands on the rope. Middle distance: the birch-bark roof and the dry kerb. Background: thin brown grass and grey roofs far down the hill. Hard low sun, two long shadows on the grass.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, hauls up a wooden bucket that drips nothing. Middle distance: Rolf, five, fair, in a brown smock too big for him, waiting on the track. Background: two thin fields of brown grass with no water on them, the river a bright line beyond. Bleached noon light.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, turns the windlass handle with both hands. Middle distance: Rolf, five, fair, in a brown smock too big for him, watching. Background: the empty bucket hanging still, one brown spider web stretched across its dry bottom. Flat afternoon light on grey stone.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, stands at a stone well with her right hand flat on the warm stone of the well mouth. Foreground: a wooden bucket on the grass, brimming full of cold water, its surface flat and still. Middle distance: the windlass and its rope, the birch-bark roof. Background: dry gold grass falling away to a river flat and a village far below. Low warm sun, long shadow.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, stands at the well with both hands on the coping and the rope slack on the drum. Middle distance: the alders below, their roots in the water. Background: the river and the dry flats, grey roofs beyond. Low sun, the scarlet coat alone on the hill.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, carries a full wooden bucket in both hands, one hand smudged black with charcoal. Middle distance: the alder roots woven into a flat mat. Background: one small round hole in the clay with water coming up. Flat daylight on the grey bank.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, lowers a full bucket into the hole in the clay, a second bucket on the mat of roots. Middle distance: the dry brown Flats, thin grass with no standing water. Background: bare alders and the wide river. Hard daylight, the scarlet coat on grey water.

Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, climbs the hill path with Rolf, five, fair, in a brown smock too big for him. Middle distance: the well on its bare patch of grass. Background: swallows going down over the reeds, the river flat, the roofs small below. Low evening sun, long gold light. Close on the hands and the object they hold, the room soft behind them.

Rolf, five, fair, in a brown smock too big for him, drinks from a wooden cup, screwing up his eyes. Middle distance: Inga, eight, black hair in two short plaits, in a bright scarlet wool coat, holding the full bucket by the rope. Background: the well, the birch roof, the flats going blue. Evening light lying flat on the water. Seen from the far end of the room, everything nearer out of focus.

Ravn, an older man grey at the temple, in a brown coat, holds a grey wool coat open over a scarred wooden bench with one finger laid on a seam. Middle distance: nine dark seam-lines run clear across the wool, a jar of pins beside it. Background: the shop window with one bare nail. Low lamplight on brown wood.

Nedo, seventeen, short sandy hair, in a bright deep green wool jacket and a leather apron, sews at the scarred bench. Middle distance: Ravn, grey at the temple, in a brown coat, standing over him, a jar of pins between them. Background: the grey coat spread on the bench with its nine dark seams, the window nail bare. Low lamplight.

Nedo, seventeen, short sandy hair, in a bright deep green wool jacket, sits alone on the scarred bench in the dark with a coat across his knees, running one finger along the seams. Middle distance: eight whole dark seams, and the ninth still bare thread. Background: the window grey with night, the cold stove, pins scattered. Thin moonlight.

Nedo, seventeen, short sandy hair, in a bright deep green wool jacket, kneels with one hand in the offcut basket. Middle distance: a strip of blue cloth nine inches long in his other hand, a grey bolt on the bench. Background: the shop window, the bare nail, the dark street. Lamplight, the blue strip the only bright colour.

Nedo, seventeen, short sandy hair, in a bright deep green wool jacket and a leather apron, stitches a strip of blue cloth into the back of a grey coat. Middle distance: the coat turned inside out on the scarred bench, a jar of pins and one long needle. Background: the window grey with early light. Cold lamplight on the blue.

A finished grey wool coat hangs on the single nail in the shop window, nine dark seam-lines clear across its back. Middle distance: the glass, a bare nail-hole beside, snow on the sill. Background: grey roofs and a snowy street with one line of footprints below. Flat white winter light, the coat the only warm thing.

Wren, the bride, in her mother's grey shawl, water running off the hem, puts her arms into the sleeves of the grey coat. Middle distance: Nedo, seventeen, short sandy hair, in a bright deep green wool jacket, holding the coat open. Background: the shop door streaming with rain, the street white beyond it. Grey window light, wet wool dark.

A blue cloth strip nine inches long lies whole on the bench, nine little knots standing up along it, and Ravn, grey at the temple, in a brown coat, turns it with his thumb. Middle distance: Nedo, seventeen, short sandy hair, in a bright deep green wool jacket. Background: the grey coat open at the back, neck to hem. Lamplight.

Ravn, grey at the temple, in a brown coat, stands with Nedo, seventeen, short sandy hair, in a bright deep green wool jacket, over the scarred bench. Middle distance: two pieces of the same grey bolt laid edge to edge, the blue strip set aside. Background: the shop window, its one nail, the winter street. Low lamplight.

A small wooden box stands open on a dresser with one blue cloth strip folded inside it. Middle distance: through the window, Wren, the bride, in her mother's grey shawl, walking by the alder roots in a whole grey coat, its nine seams unbroken. Background: the river, bare grey trees. Flat winter light from the window.

A wooden board hangs over the hearth with ninety-eight notches cut in it and two blank spaces at the end. Middle distance: Ketil, an old man with a grey beard and a fur collar, a thumb on the board. Background: Turi, eleven, tousled brown hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater, looking up. Low firelight, deep shadow in the roof.

Turi, eleven, tousled brown hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater, kneels on a bare back-room floor with one board lifted up. Middle distance: a tin box with ships on the lid, open, and a small strip of paper folded in four in his hand. Background: dust, a stone wall, one low window. Grey window light on the boards.

A scrubbed kitchen table with the folded paper strip lying on it. Middle distance: Vesla, white hair, in a brown shawl, turning the strip over with one finger; Turi, eleven, tousled brown hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater, across the table from her. Background: the hearth, a hanging lamp, bare stone walls. Warm lamplight on the board.

Turi, eleven, tousled brown hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater, stands on the shingle in front of Vesla, white hair, in a brown shawl, his hand flat on his coat pocket. Middle distance: the bank of loose shingle and gravel. Background: one long black line of water, dirty ice behind it, small figures up the bank. Flat white light.

Ketil, an old man with a grey beard and a fur collar, steps forward on the shingle with one hand lifted. Middle distance: the flat gravel and the one long black line of water against the bank. Background: rows of small dark figures standing in the wind, dirty ice behind them. Hard grey light, no shadow on the water.

Wet grey gravel at the edge of the river, with water lying level over it and one thin dark line standing against the stones. Middle distance: shingle running away along the bank. Background: dirty ice, bare alders, a low grey sky. Cold flat light, the water glassy and completely still.

Old men in fur caps stand in a close row on the shingle, turning their heads to one another, their faces shut. Middle distance: loose shingle and gravel. Background: the long black line of water against the bank, dirty ice above it. Flat grey light, nothing moving but the corners of their coats.

Vesla, white hair, in a brown shawl, has her hand inside Turi's coat pocket, taking out the strip of paper folded in four. Middle distance: Turi, eleven, tousled brown hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater, standing still. Background: the black line of water on the shingle bank, dirty ice behind. Flat winter light on the strip.

Vesla, white hair, in a brown shawl, stands knee-deep at the water edge, her open fingers held flat as the folded paper strip lifts out of them. Middle distance: shingle shifting and turning where her boots are. Background: the black water and the dirty ice above it. Cold flat light, no splash at all.

A wooden board hangs over a hearth with ninety-nine notches cut in it and one blank space left. Middle distance: Ketil, a grey beard and a fur collar, cutting the notch with a small knife; Vesla, white hair, in a brown shawl, holding the empty tin box. Background: bare stone walls, a low window. Firelight in one small room.

Randi, about forty, grey hair pinned up, in a dark red shawl over a white apron, kneels at the flour bin with a bread knife, the lid up. Middle distance: flour white on the dark red shawl and on the flags. Background: the shut bakehouse door, the iron oven banked cold, bare stone walls. Grey night light from one shutter.

Randi, about forty, grey hair pinned up, in a dark red shawl over a white apron, stands at the iron oven with a round loaf on the scrubbed oak board, its brown crust cracking. Middle distance: the oven door open on one glowing coal. Background: the bakehouse, bare stone walls, snow light at a window. Warm firelight, grey shadows.

The scrubbed oak board with a round loaf broken into nine pieces fanned in a rough circle. Middle distance: Randi, grey hair pinned up, in a dark red shawl over a white apron, sliding a tenth piece under the red-and-white checked cloth and pressing it flat. Background: the low table, the flour bin, the cold oven. Lamplight on the cloth.

Randi, about forty, grey hair pinned up, in a dark red shawl over a white apron, opens a small grey chalky piece of bread in her two hands, no steam rising. Middle distance: the checked cloth, and the board with the nine pieces on it. Background: the low table, the banked oven, a bare wall. Cold lamplight on her hands.

Nine plates stand in a row on the table, one piece on each, nine small children crowding in with wet shawls and boots. Middle distance: Randi, grey hair pinned up, in a dark red shawl over a white apron, handing over the last plate. Background: the baby Osa wailing in her wooden box by the bin. Firelight.

The low table with nine empty plates, butter smeared round the scrubbed oak board. Middle distance: Jonna with bread in both fists, and the baby Osa with a crust in one hand and a hand of bread over her ear. Background: eight other children, the shutter pushed by the wind, the oven. Warm low light, nobody talking.

Randi, about forty, grey hair pinned up, in a dark red shawl over a white apron, sits alone at the low table, turning one grey hard piece the size of her palm over in her hand. Middle distance: the red-and-white checked cloth, empty and flat. Background: the cold oven, the stairs, the baby's wooden box. Lamplight on her hands.

The red-and-white checked cloth lies open and empty on the scrubbed table, one crumb on the checked squares. Middle distance: the bare table top and the stools pushed in. Background: the cold iron oven, bare stone walls, snow light at a window. Flat winter light, nobody in the room.

A birch stump stands at the north edge of a wood, snow lying in the trodden ground round it. Middle distance: dark pines bowed hard over, every branch one way. Background: a low grey sky, a far field of barley flattened flat, village roofs small below. Cold overcast light, the snow grey-white.

Timo, eight, dark hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater under an open blue coat, holds a round loaf in both bare hands. Middle distance: an older pair of hands still pushing the loaf into his. Background: the top of the lane, the edge of the wood, the wind moving the grass. Low dusk light on his upturned face.

Timo, eight, dark hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater under an open blue coat, carries the round loaf in both bare hands, his own fingerprints pressed into the crust. Middle distance: the bare grey plank on two field stones, no cloth, no knife, no cup. Background: dark pines bowed, a low grey sky. Cold flat light.

Timo, eight, dark hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater under an open blue coat, holds both bare hands out with the round loaf. Middle distance: the brown crust lifting off the top of the loaf as one piece. Background: the bending pines, the grey sky, snow on the ground. Flat cold light, nothing falling.

Timo, eight, dark hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater under an open blue coat, his two bare hands held out flat palm up, with three ragged pieces of loaf lying across them and crumbs in the creases. Middle distance: the empty air where the loaf was. Background: the bowed pines, a low grey sky. Cold light, no crumb falling.

Timo, eight, dark hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater under an open blue coat, stands with the three pieces in his open hands. Middle distance: the bare grey plank on two field stones behind him. Background: pines moving hard, a far field of barley flattened. Cold grey light, the orange sweater the only warmth.

Timo, eight, dark hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater under an open blue coat, stands with his hands out and the three pieces still lying on them. Middle distance: the bare plank on two field stones. Background: the pines standing perfectly still, the barley unmoving, one grey sky. Dead flat light, nothing moving at all.

Timo, eight, dark hair, in a bright orange knitted sweater under an open blue coat, holds one hand out and the three pieces in the other. Middle distance: the bare grey plank on two field stones, empty, with snow lying on it. Background: the motionless pines, the first thin light at the edge of the sky. Cold blue-grey light.

A table stands at the north edge of the wood: a grey plank on two field stones, a red-and-white checked cloth, a knife, and a wooden cup of water with a pinch of salt. Middle distance: a round loaf set down on the cloth. Background: dark pines, a low grey sky, snow on the ground. Cold morning light.

An old woman stands by a low stone well at the edge of the village with her hands on the coping. Middle distance: the path going up to the wood, empty. Background: village roofs, a bare field, a low grey sky. Cold flat light, one long shadow from the well across the path.
